data.raw_text:
Members of the militant group Sandugo, march toward the Senate of the Philippines to call on senators to continue the impeachment proceedings against Vice President Sara Duterte over allegations involving the misuse of public funds, May 12, 2026.

The group said the Filipino people deserve justice and accountability, adding that anyone accused of wrongdoing must answer before the law, especially in matters involving taxpayers’ money. 

During the protest, the group was confronted by supporters of Senator Ronald “Bato” dela Rosa, who allegedly attempted to destroy the protesters’ placards as tensions briefly rose near the Senate grounds. (📷Mark Balmores/MB)
